scenario_description: Every tracked source file is tied to Git history and frozen upstream scans.
expected: Every tracked Blackridge Python source file has a hash and first-add history.
Every upstream checkout resolves to the requested immutable commit.
Exact matches are reported with file locations; zero matches is not called proof.
observed: Inspected all 22 file rows: each has SHA-256, line count, and a concrete Git first-add commit.
Verified four observed checkout commits equal the frozen requested commits and together cover 1133 upstream source files.
The normalized six-line scan reported zero matches and its evidence explicitly retains three limitations instead of asserting originality.
notes: Manual file-by-file and upstream-scope inspection satisfied the evidence contract; this is not a legal originality opinion.
